text:
lee: FYI scheduling a narrow maintenance window for a small ABI shim + quant tweak (quant=int8-v2.1) — goal is low-risk swap with ephemeral pin. window 03:30-04:30 UTC. plan: 1% canary -> 10% -> 100%. deadman unpin + auto-rollback on bad signals.

ana: can you call out the deadman timings? last time a pin stuck overnight and caught customers.

lee: deadman: pin TTL=45m, auto-unpin at 05:15 UTC if not promoted. immediate rollback if error-rate delta >3% or p50 latency +80ms sustained 5m. also will enable synthetic smoke traffic for noisy customers.

phil: routing request: enable shadowing to the shim for 2% of traffic (logs only) for 15m preflight. helps catch model-level regressions.

deploybot: [scheduled] release job: rb/abi-ephemeral-quant-2026-03-24 (canary 1%). start=03:30 UTC notify=#eng-runtime

sre-night: onwatch for this window. PD policy: error-rate >3% or p99 >200ms -> PD. Im Sam and Ill page.

docs: Ill draft the release blurb. need exact fallback names and customer-facing impact text.

lee: fallback variants: engine:compat-stable and engine:compat-thermal-lite. customer impact: internal-only kernel ABI bump, minimal surface change; advise support to use fallback if customers report anomalies.

phil: preflight steps: 1) bundle-checksum across 6 staging nodes 2) synthetic smoke set (trace ids: smoke-ephemeral-*) 3) tail-latency probe across thermal nodes. abort on checksum mismatch.

deploybot: command: /release start rb/abi-ephemeral-quant-2026-03-24 --canary=1 --ttl=45m --notify #eng-runtime

lee: also enabling a deadman rollback hook: if PD fires within first 30m, automatic traffic shift -> 0 and fallback route applied.

sre-night: I'll keep an eye on traces and mark any new error class. set me as contact in the release metadata.

phil: quick manual rollback snippet in case we need it:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/release/shift \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN" \ 
  -d '{"release":"rb/abi-ephemeral-quant-2026-03-24","to":0,"fallback":"engine:compat-stable"}'
```

deploybot: [running] canary started 03:30 UTC at 1%. metrics endpoint: /metrics/release/rb/abi-ephemeral-quant-2026-03-24

docs: draft published internal: https://docs.internal/releases/rb-abi-ephemeral-2026-03-24. text: "ABI shim + quant:int8-v2.1; fallback: engine:compat-stable / compat-thermal-lite; auto-rollback rules: error/p50 thresholds + checksum gate."

sre-night: seeing a tiny p95 blip +12ms at +4m, no error increase. continuing watch.

lee: if clean at +15m we'll move to 10%. otherwise hold and investigate traces with trace ids smoke-ephemeral-*.

phil: confirmed bundle-checksum passed on all 6 staging nodes at 03:15 UTC. good to go.

deploybot: [status] 10% shift started at 03:55 UTC.

sre-night: brief p99 spike to 180ms for 2m after 10% shift, no error rise. marking as transient.

lee: promoting to 100% at 04:15 UTC if nothing else. remember to clear canary pin and publish final build sha.

deploybot: [done] rollout completed 04:17 UTC. build sha: sha256:0a1b2c3d4e5f67890abcdeffedcba9876543210f

lee: clearing pin now and updating runbook with the build sha and the deadman timeline.

docs: final note updated and sent to support/product. thanks team.

sre-night: closing watch. no PDs. good job team :tada:
